reason: I grab Monster or Big Shock 4-packs on offer and pay maybe 25 to 30 crowns a can, so 55 for one can of something I suspect tastes like grass tea is twice what I pay to get through a night shift. I don't need it to be clean, I need it to work and be cheap.
objection: Fifty-five crowns a can for unsweetened yerba mate that will probably taste bitter, with less of a kick than what I already drink.
would_change_my_mind: A multipack deal that brings it near 30 crowns a can, or a free sample that proves it doesn't taste like grass.
